"""Independent finite R4 probes; no original documents/models/catalog IO."""
import json
from dataclasses import asdict
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from company_wiki.source_catalog import narrative_business_policy as owner
from company_wiki.document_understanding.operating_states.assertion_roles import prepare_source_assertions
from company_wiki.document_normalization.text_matching import matching_reading_text

WT = Path('C:/Users/郑曾波/Projects/company-wiki/tmp/architecture-r2')
assert Path(owner.__file__).resolve() == (WT / 'src/company_wiki/source_catalog/narrative_business_policy.py').resolve()
OBSERVED = []


def assessment(text):
    raw = prepare_source_assertions(text)
    result = owner.prepare_reading_business_assessment(text, {'relations': []})
    OBSERVED.append({'text': text, 'raw_payload': raw.independent_payload,
                     'raw_scope': raw.source_scope, 'prepared_payload': result.source_roles.independent_payload,
                     'prepared_scope': result.source_roles.source_scope, 'fact': asdict(result.fact),
                     'passage': asdict(result.passage), 'source_roles': asdict(result.source_roles)})
    (Path(__file__).parent / 'observations.json').write_text(json.dumps(OBSERVED, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
    return raw, result


@pytest.mark.parametrize('text', [
    'Our platform supports remarkable ambitions.',
    'Our platform supports promising possibilities.',
    'Our platform supports unfamiliar technical endeavours.',
    'We aim to pursue luminous horizons.',
    'Our platform plans to support remarkable ambitions.',
    'Our platform supports courageous intentions.',
    'Our software supports wondrous tomorrows.',
    'We aim to pursue plausible trajectories.',
    'Our services include uncharted tending and celestial nurturing.',
    'Our services include celestial nurturing and uncharted tending.',
])
def test_prior_five_and_unseen_unknowns_cannot_supply_proof(text):
    raw, result = assessment(text)
    assert raw.independent_payload is None and result.source_roles.independent_payload is None
    assert not result.source_roles.bound_payload and not result.source_roles.source_scope
    assert result.passage.use == 'unresolved' and not result.passage.relevant
    assert not result.fact.eligible and not result.fact.financial_exempt
    assert ''.join(r.text for r in result.source_roles.clauses).strip(' .。') == matching_reading_text(text).strip(' .。')


@pytest.mark.parametrize('text', [
    'Our product portfolio includes recycling systems.',
    'Our production services cover downstream assembly workflows.',
    '我们的设备服务覆盖客户的灌溉作业。',
])
def test_declared_scope_preserves_the_original_payload_axis(text):
    from company_wiki.source_catalog.narrative_business_disclosures import reading_material_value
    raw, result = assessment(text)
    assert result.source_roles.independent_payload is raw.independent_payload
    assert result.source_roles.source_scope and result.passage.relevant
    assert result.passage.use == 'support'
    assert not {'operating_milestone', 'operating_current_state'} & set(result.fact.reasons)
    if raw.independent_payload is None:
        assert reading_material_value(result.fact, source_roles=result.source_roles) == 'description'
        assert not result.fact.eligible and not result.fact.financial_exempt
    else:
        # Review-probe erratum: assembly already has the unchanged argument
        # owner's positive semantic proof; scope must not erase that proof.
        assert text == 'Our production services cover downstream assembly workflows.'
        assert raw.independent_payload is True and result.fact.eligible


@pytest.mark.parametrize('text', [
    'Our teams recover helium from exhausted gas streams.',
    'Our vessels transport liquefied gas between inland terminals.',
])
def test_unfamiliar_actual_action_keeps_readable_source_words(text):
    _raw, result = assessment(text)
    assert result.passage.use == 'support' and result.passage.relevant


@pytest.mark.parametrize('text', [
    'Our software supports customer engagement.',
    'Net income was $20 million. Our platform supports remarkable ambitions.',
    'Revenue rose because our platform supports remarkable ambitions.',
    'Which equipment is used in rural clinics',
    'Our equipment that is used in rural clinics.',
    'We aim to create value for hospitals whose systems process orders.',
])
def test_financial_nonassertion_and_beneficiary_do_not_borrow_scope(text):
    _raw, result = assessment(text)
    assert result.passage.use != 'support' and not result.passage.relevant
    assert not result.fact.eligible and not result.fact.financial_exempt


def test_typed_numeric_coverage_keeps_real_proof_without_current_state():
    _raw, result = assessment('Our sales services cover 23 regional markets.')
    assert result.fact.eligible and 'business_coverage_relation' in result.fact.reasons
    assert result.passage.use == 'support' and result.passage.relevant
    assert not {'operating_milestone', 'operating_current_state'} & set(result.fact.reasons)


def test_direct_quantity_goal_is_not_a_current_number_or_a_beneficiary_quantity():
    _raw, direct = assessment('We aim to serve 1700 customers and create value.')
    assert direct.passage.use == 'unresolved' and direct.passage.relevant
    assert not {'operating_quantity', 'operating_metric_change', 'operating_current_state'} & set(direct.fact.reasons)
    _raw, indirect = assessment('We aim to create value for 1700 customers.')
    assert indirect.passage.use != 'support' and not indirect.passage.relevant
    assert not indirect.fact.eligible


def test_scope_recipe_changes_actual_generation_cache_for_text_and_pdf(monkeypatch):
    from company_wiki.automation.narrative_generation import current_reading_decision_matches
    from company_wiki.document_understanding.decision_dependencies import freeze_decision_dependencies
    from company_wiki.source_catalog import narrative_decision_inventory as inventory
    from company_wiki.source_catalog import narrative_source_context as scope_owner
    from company_wiki.source_catalog.narrative_pdf_layout import PDF_READING_LAYOUT_FEATURE_VERSION
    from unit.document_understanding_selection.test_reading_decision_inventory import _real_interim_pipeline
    manifests = []
    for mime in ['text/plain', 'application/pdf']:
        pipeline = _real_interim_pipeline()
        pipeline['observation']['metadata']['mime_type'] = mime
        if mime == 'application/pdf':
            pipeline['observation']['metadata']['native_layout_frontend_version'] = PDF_READING_LAYOUT_FEATURE_VERSION
        frozen = freeze_decision_dependencies(inventory.build_decision_trace(pipeline))
        assert frozen['status'] == 'complete'
        manifest = {'reading_dependencies': frozen, 'selection_generation': {'decision_digest': frozen['decision_digest']}}
        assert current_reading_decision_matches(manifest)
        manifests.append(manifest)
    target = Path(scope_owner.__file__).resolve()
    original = Path.read_bytes
    monkeypatch.setattr(Path, 'read_bytes', lambda path: original(path) + b'\n# independent scope algorithm mutation\n'
                        if path.resolve() == target else original(path))
    assert all(not current_reading_decision_matches(manifest) for manifest in manifests)

import ast
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

ROOT = Path('C:/Users/郑曾波/Projects/company-wiki')
WT = ROOT / 'tmp/architecture-r2'
OUT = ROOT / 'tmp/j4'
REPORTS = ROOT / 'docs/plans/du11-source-closure-2026-10-18/review/architecture-quality-20261101/implementation-results'
before = json.loads((REPORTS / 'R6-source-ci-r3.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
author = json.loads((REPORTS / 'R6-source-ci-r4.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
gate = json.loads((REPORTS / 'R6-daily-feedback-simplification.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))

def sha(x): return hashlib.sha256(x).hexdigest()
def git(*args): return subprocess.check_output(['git', *args], cwd=WT)

head = git('rev-parse', 'HEAD').decode().strip()
assert head == '2b0787dc1c5352cd8566fc71fc585afe735ec75c'
seal = {}
for name, expected in {**author['source_and_test_sha256'], **gate['changed_files_sha256']}.items():
    data = (WT / name).read_bytes()
    blob = git('show', f'{head}:{name}')
    seal[name] = {'raw_sha256': sha(data), 'expected': expected, 'raw_match': sha(data) == expected,
                  'git_lf_sha256': sha(blob), 'git_lf_match': data.replace(b'\r\n', b'\n') == blob}
assert all(x['raw_match'] and x['git_lf_match'] for x in seal.values())
oracles = ['tests/unit/document_understanding_selection/test_reading_native_continuity.py',
 'tests/unit/document_understanding_selection/test_reading_value_coverage.py',
 'tests/unit/document_understanding_selection/test_source_support_use.py',
 'tests/unit/du11_production/test_business_coverage_relations.py',
 'tests/unit/du11_production/test_source_information_payload.py',
 'tests/unit/du11_production/test_source_readability_deferred_selection.py',
 'tests/integration/test_source_processing_handler_wire.py']
unchanged = {}
for name in oracles:
    old, current = git('show', f'a6841e94:{name}'), git('show', f'{head}:{name}')
    unchanged[name] = {'same': old == current, 'git_blob_sha256': sha(current)}
assert all(x['same'] for x in unchanged.values())
all_runs = []
for report in [before, author]:
    for run in report['runs']:
        path = Path(run['junit'])
        data = path.read_bytes()
        assert sha(data) == run['sha256'], run['name']
        cases = [(n.get('classname'), n.get('name')) for n in ET.fromstring(data).iter('testcase')]
        semantic = [name for cls, name in cases if cls.endswith('test_source_semantic_axes')]
        all_runs.append({'name': run['name'], 'sha256': sha(data), 'cases': len(cases),
                         'semantic_cases': len(semantic), 'semantic_names': semantic})
old_run = next(x for x in all_runs if x['name'] == 'r6-r3-np-final')
new_run = next(x for x in all_runs if x['name'] == 'r6-r4-domain-frozen')
old_set, new_set = set(old_run['semantic_names']), set(new_run['semantic_names'])
identity_diff = {'r3_final_semantic_count': len(old_set), 'r4_final_semantic_count': len(new_set),
                 'removed_case_ids': sorted(old_set - new_set), 'added_case_ids': sorted(new_set - old_set),
                 'all_historical_run_counts': [{k:v for k,v in r.items() if k != 'semantic_names'} for r in all_runs]}
data = {'head': head, 'branch': git('branch', '--show-current').decode().strip(),
        'seal': seal, 'unchanged_original_oracles': unchanged,
        'author_runs_sha_verified': len(all_runs), 'case_identity_diff': identity_diff,
        'authorized_errata': author['authorized_test_errata'],
        'status_before': git('status', '--short').decode().strip(),
        'excluded_untracked': 'tests/unit/document_understanding_note_scope/ (T3; not collected/not reviewed)'}
role_path = 'src/company_wiki/document_understanding/operating_states/assertion_roles.py'
def function_ast(source, name):
    return ast.dump(next(n for n in ast.parse(source).body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == name), include_attributes=False)
data['original_argument_payload_ast_unchanged'] = (function_ast(git('show', f'a6841e94:{role_path}').decode(), '_argument_payload')
    == function_ast((WT / role_path).read_text(encoding='utf-8'), '_argument_payload'))
assert data['original_argument_payload_ast_unchanged']
(OUT / 'seal.json').write_text(json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'head': head, 'seal_count': len(seal), 'oracles_unchanged': len(unchanged),
                  'junit_sha_verified': len(all_runs), 'identity_diff': {k:v for k,v in identity_diff.items()
                    if k != 'all_historical_run_counts'}}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
